reasons.correctness: SupportTicket gains `@Version private Long version` and the changeset adds `version BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL` to support_ticket, both as the interface specifies. Build is green and the hidden tests pass 2/2.
reasons.convention_fit: The changeset lives under 2026/09/ with a DD-MM-YYYY kebab name, a liquibase header, a changeset id and a rollback line. It is included last in changelog.xml under a `<!-- September 2026 -->` comment. No existing changeset was edited.
reasons.design_fit: Minimal footprint: one field on the entity, one changeset, one include. It reuses JPA @Version, the same mechanism as 20-12-2025-add-version-to-applied-opportunity.sql. There is no new class or parallel locking mechanism.
reasons.test_quality: VersionTests in SupportTicketEntityUnitTest only asserts null-before-persist and a getter/setter round trip. Nothing checks the @Version annotation or that a stale update is rejected.
reasons.graph_use: The first step was a graph query that located the support/ticket files, and SupportTicket.java was read next. The existing @Version example and the changeset pattern were found by grep, not by the graph.
